# stalwart_encryption (Data Source)

Configures encryption at rest and the encryption gateway. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `at_rest_enable` (Boolean) Encrypt stored messages for accounts that configured encryption at rest
- `discovery_proxy` (String) HTTP proxy for key fetches and certificate revocation list downloads
- `gateway_enable` (Boolean) Enable the encryption gateway, which encrypts messages for remote recipients and maintains their public keys
- `gateway_encrypt_signed` (Boolean) Whether to encrypt messages that are signed but not encrypted
- `gateway_header_protection` (String) Header protection for messages encrypted for remote recipients. Signed messages are not header protected.
- `gateway_methods` (Set of String) Key types the gateway encrypts with; when a DNS lookup returns both an OpenPGP key and an S/MIME certificate for a new key, the certificate is stored
- `gateway_min_trust` (Attributes) Minimum trust level a key needs before it is used for a recipient (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateway_min_trust))
- `gateway_outbound` (Attributes) When to encrypt a message for a recipient with a stored key (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateway_outbound))
- `harvest_keys` (Attributes) Whether to learn the S/MIME certificate or Autocrypt key of an authenticated sender from a received message; a valid OpenPGP signature on the message raises the trust level of an Autocrypt key (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--harvest_keys))
- `hkp_servers` (Set of String) Keyservers queried for keys that use the HKP discovery method
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `key_refresh_interval` (Number) How often keys are fetched again from their discovery method
- `max_crl_size` (Number) Maximum size of a downloaded certificate revocation list
- `negative_cache_ttl` (Number) How long an address with no key is remembered before the store is read again
- `source_timeout` (Number) Maximum time spent fetching one key
- `use_bundled_roots` (Boolean) Trust the bundled Mozilla S/MIME root certificates when validating recipient certificates
